title: Stability of Turnover Rate: A Volume-Stable Turnover Factor for Stock Selection
tldr: The volume-stable turnover factor STR, built as the 20-day standard deviation of daily turnover, beats traditional turnover and turnover-change factors with annualized ICIR -2.72 and long-short IR 2.96.
abstract: This report extends Dongwu Financial Engineering's 'technical-analysis-embraces-selection-factors' series (part 7), continuing the exploration of turnover factors. The authors note that the traditional turnover factor Turn20 misjudges many future winners in its high-turnover decile, where intra-group future-return dispersion is large. To address this, they construct the volume-stable turnover factor STR (Stability of Turnover Rate): each month-end they take the standard deviation of the past 20 trading days' daily turnover and apply cross-sectional market-cap neutralization. Backtested on all A-shares from 2006-01-01 to 2021-04-30, STR achieves monthly IC mean -0.079, annualized ICIR -2.72, long-short annualized return 42.99%, IR 2.96, monthly win rate 77.60%, and max drawdown 11.08%, substantially outperforming Turn20 and PctTurn20. A purified STR factor net of Barra styles and industries still retains selection power.
strategy: Monthly cross-sectional long-short selection: rank all A-shares by the STR factor (20-day standard deviation of daily turnover, market-cap neutralized), form 10 groups, and go long the low-turnover-volatility decile / short the high-turnover-volatility decile, since the factor IC is negative (low STR predicts higher future returns). The paper states '在月度选股上，如果我们发现一只股票的换手率很高，不可轻易将其归为空头，若它每天都能保持同样的高换手，即换手率的稳定性较高，那么这只股票下个月仍然有大涨的希望' [source: "换手的稳定性较高，那么这只股票下个月仍然有大涨的希望"]. Rebalanced monthly; also tested on CSI 300 and CSI 500 universes and with lookback windows of 40 and 60 days.
method: Factor construction and cross-sectional backtest. STR is computed each month-end as the standard deviation of the past 20 trading days' daily turnover, then cross-sectionally market-cap neutralized. Baselines are the traditional turnover factor Turn20 (20-day mean daily turnover, market-cap neutralized) and the turnover-change factor PctTurn20 (daily turnover change rate = daily_turnover / base_turnover - 1, where base is the average of the prior X=40 days, averaged over 20 days, market-cap neutralized). Evaluation uses monthly IC, RankIC, annualized ICIR/RankICIR, 10-group monotonicity, and long-short hedge annualized return, volatility, information ratio, monthly win rate, and max drawdown. Orthogonalization against Turn20/PctTurn20 and against the volatility factor Vol20 yields STR_deVol20; a purified factor regresses STR on Barra style factors and 28 Shenwan level-1 industry dummies. [source: "每月月底，回溯每只股票过去 20 个交易日，计算其 20 日换手率的标准差；在横截面上做市值中性化处理"]
experiment: Backtest period 2006-01-01 to 2021-04-30 on all A-shares (universe exclusions not explicitly enumerated in the text). Data source: Wind. Frequency: monthly rebalancing at month-end with 20-day (also 40 and 60-day) lookback. Market-cap neutralization is cross-sectional. Benchmarks/universes: all A-shares, plus CSI 300 and CSI 500 components. Transaction costs are not explicitly stated in the extracted text. Key parameters: lookback window N=20 days (sensitivity tested at 40, 60); PctTurn20 base window X=40 days. Style-neutralization uses Barra style factors and 28 Shenwan level-1 industry dummy variables. [source: "回测期 2006/01/01-2021/04/30 内，以全体 A 股为研究样本"]
result: STR factor (all A-shares, 2006-01-01 to 2021-04-30): monthly IC mean -0.079, RankIC mean -0.109, annualized ICIR -2.72, annualized RankICIR -3.34; 10-group long-short hedge annualized return 42.99%, annualized volatility 14.51%, information ratio 2.96, monthly win rate 77.60%, max drawdown 11.08%, substantially beating Turn20 (33.41%, IR 1.90, DD 22.03%) and PctTurn20 (21.85%, IR 1.82, DD 16.25%). Long-only excess: 17.80% return, IR 2.23, DD 6.54%. Purified STR (net of Barra styles + industries): 22.96% annualized, IR 2.92, win rate 82.56%, DD 9.69%. STR_deVol20 (net of Vol20): ICIR -3.58, 32.98% return, IR 3.14, DD 7.65%. CSI 300: 9.20%/IR 0.42; CSI 500: 24.87%/IR 1.46. [source: "年化 ICIR 为-2.72；10 分组多空对冲的年化收益为 42.99%，年化波动为 14.51%，信息比率为 2.96，月度胜率为 77.60%，最大回撤为 11.08%"]
